title: Rolling signal
description: A fine waveform retains recent signal history so it can be held and inspected.
useCase: Inspect the recent history of a continuous signal.
interaction: Hold the signal, then scrub its retained history.
reducedMotion: The stream stops; the retained history remains inspectable.
limitations: A generated signal with 900 retained samples; no microphone or stored audio.
look: Warm off-white page with a fine maroon bar waveform over faint vertical gridlines, a monospace time axis, a solid maroon button and a grey slider.
motion: New samples arrive at 30 per second, scrolling the bar waveform leftward in steps; pressing hold freezes the stream so the history slider can scrub up to 650 samples back.
adapt: `setInterval` at 30 Hz appends `sample` values to the 900-entry `history` buffer, and `draw` paints the last 180 (`count`) shifted by `offset`. Replace `sample` with a live feed and keep the `held` and reduced-motion gating.
